title: athyrium mongolicum
intro: Athyrium mongolicum, commonly known as Mongolian lady fern, is a type of flowering plant in the fern family (Athyriaceae) native to China and Mongolia. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine to provide various health benefits, including its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium mongolicum include acting as an antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
